items.title: Print milestone_status table after milestone-aware mutating commands
items.context: Add a mechanical post-command output path so commands like checklist_update, verification_evidence_batch_add, verification_evidence_refresh_stale, story_advance, delivery_check_save, summary_set, and milestone_ledger_set/add append the same human table as `lattice milestone_status --storyId=<id>` when the story has a milestone ledger.
items.userSees: After a successful state change, stdout shows the command result and then `Milestone Status - B-demo` with `Completed`, `Current`, and `Remaining` table sections.

happy.desc: A representative state-changing command for a story with milestone-ledger.json appends the consumed milestone_status Markdown table to stdout.

edge.desc: The post-command table is skipped for commands using --json or --format=json so machine-readable stdout remains parseable JSON.
A story without milestone-ledger.json does not receive a fabricated milestone progress table after mutation.

adversarial.desc: The appended table must be produced by the same milestone_status renderer and include `Milestone Status - <storyId>`, `Completed`, `Current`, and `Remaining`, not a bespoke summary string.

items.title: Cover stdout contract with regression tests
items.context: Add focused tests proving a representative state-change command emits `Milestone Status - B-xxxx`, `Completed`, `Current`, and `Remaining` in stdout instead of silently consuming milestone_status.
